method: Every numeric design parameter (1,107 values) was read against its source quote, and the page text where the quote was unclear. Each got a qualifier (min, max, design, typical, range or average) and a verdict: ok; weak (the quote does not show the value or is about a related practice); corrected (the quote states a different number; corrected_value applied); or removed (not this requirement, e.g. a construction practice or a maintenance drain). Water-quality depths also record whether the depth is rainfall or runoff.
